command: const fs=require("fs"),crypto=require("crypto");for(const mode of ["baseline","a001"]){const record=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`docs/evidence/SP-T002/worker/a002-final-delta-01-${mode}.json`));for(const item of record.implementation){const actual=crypto.createHash("sha256").update(fs.readFileSync(item.path)).digest("hex");if(actual!==item.afterSha256)throw Error(item.path+" changed after freeze")}if(record.outsidePacket.length)throw Error("outside-packet delta");console.log(mode+": "+record.implementation.length+" implementation hashes match")}
